name: client_ping
title: Ping Host
description: Checks whether the selected HHC client is reachable through the hub and reports session freshness. Read-only; never executes anything on the host. Use for connectivity checks, not full system inspection; prefer system_snapshot when host status is needed.

client_id.description: Target HHC client. Absolute routing handle, independent of any connection.

status.description: completed on success, failed on error.

client_id.description: Echo of the target host id (null when no host was targeted).

reachable.description: Whether the host has a live session.

online.description: Whether the host is marked online.

last_seen_age_ms.description: Milliseconds since the host was last seen (null when never seen).

error.description: Machine-readable error code when status is failed.

retryable.description: Whether a failed call may succeed on retry.
